answer: Correlated Genesis Penalty (CGP): each new agent enters an oasis pool; first tasks yield velvet-tier microcredits in a sparrow-tagged escrow. Maturity requires randomized cooldowns plus cross-checks with non-cohort agents. Clones minted together share cohort fingerprints, so one failure co-freezes all their escrows. Attacker must fund many time-separated, diverse histories and absorb delayed liquidity; an honest agent just waits normal cooldown.
